using CUDA
import JACC
JACC.@init_backend
using JSON3

v = JACC.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0])
red = JACC.@parallel_reduce(range = 4, ((i, x) -> x[i]^2)(v))

out = Dict(
    "typeof_red" => string(typeof(red)),
    "red_value_via_show" => sprint(show, red),
    "isa_number" => red isa Number,
    "isa_abstractarray" => red isa AbstractArray,
)

# also test: can we do plain host arithmetic + JACC.array boxing on it?
try
    combined = 10.0 + red
    out["combined_ok"] = true
    out["combined_type"] = string(typeof(combined))
catch e
    out["combined_ok"] = false
    out["combined_err"] = sprint(showerror, e)
end

try
    boxed = JACC.array([red])
    out["box_ok"] = true
    out["box_type"] = string(typeof(boxed))
catch e
    out["box_ok"] = false
    out["box_err"] = sprint(showerror, e)
end

println(JSON3.write(out))
